_comment: The one source for lint_project (the build connector) and tenant-grammar.md. profile: build = error before any upload; ship = error before promotion, warning before; warning/info never block. G00 is the schema validation upload_project already runs.

rules.title: Schema validation
rules.message: The manifest and every XML file reachable through xlink:href validate against the published schemas
rules.fix: Read the validator's message; the reference card for the element names its attributes and children

rules.title: Manifest shape
rules.message: index.xml has the root <application>; version sits on <about>, never on <process>
rules.fix: Move version to <about version="...">

rules.title: View file names
rules.message: No view file is named view.xml; view names are unique
rules.fix: Name views after their screen

rules.title: XPath functions
rules.message: Expressions use only the XPath functions the tenant's verifier accepts; number() is rejected
rules.fix: Rewrite with the functions the reference documents

allowed_xpath_functions.status: to be measured on a tenant

rules.title: call value=
rules.message: The call operation names its target with value=, not step=
rules.fix: <operation name="call" value="..."/>; a bare <call axis step> is valid only inside navigate

rules.title: Flattened HTML in views
rules.message: No <select>, <option> or <a> in a view: the tenant's view dialect flattens them; raw HTML renders only through listview XSL
rules.fix: Use the reference's components, or move the markup into listview XSL

rules.title: Start step with scripts
rules.message: A <process> with <script href> has <step id="start">
rules.fix: Add the start step

rules.title: Package-local hrefs
rules.message: Every xlink:href resolves inside the package; no ..
rules.fix: Fix the path or add the file

rules.title: Custom component tags
rules.message: Tags in <components> are NCNames and do not collide with native component names
rules.fix: Prefix them (CA_...)

rules.title: ASCII text files
rules.message: Every served text file is ASCII; non-ASCII is escaped
rules.fix: Escape as &#x...;, \XXXX or \uXXXX

rules.title: One token block
rules.message: No hex colours in views or styles; exactly one scoped token block with literal values and an explicit font-family
rules.fix: Tokens in layout/, as the design kit generates them

rules.title: External calls through a proxy
rules.message: No fetch( or XMLHttpRequest to an external host; external calls go through a proxy channel and callService
rules.fix: See ai-and-integrations-via-proxy.md

rules.title: No secrets in the package
rules.message: No key- or token-shaped strings anywhere in the package
rules.fix: Move the value to the proxy's configuration; rotate it if it was committed

rules.title: home:// writes on a public share
rules.message: A tenant-target package writes to home:// without a guard; a public share has no home:// drive
rules.fix: Guard the step on a signed-in user, or write to the tenant container

rules.title: XSL for-each over node sets
rules.message: Render XSL uses for-each with call-template over node sets, not apply-templates with match patterns; no
rules.fix: Rewrite the template

rules.title: Font weight
rules.message: A font file over 200 KB
rules.fix: A subset, or the runtime's own icon set

rules.title: Upload limits
rules.message: At most 500 files, 2 MB each, 8 MB in all, text only
rules.fix: Split, minify, or upload binaries through the console

rules.title: proxy under channel
rules.message: <proxy> under a channel operation: expected, deploy with Deploy Anyway
rules.fix: Nothing

rules.title: Deployment prefix
rules.message: The deployment or URL prefix is [a-z0-9]+ and does not begin with xios
rules.fix: Rename

rules.title: Named components resolve
rules.message: Every trigger's view and component, and every {#view#component} reference, resolves to a named component
rules.fix: Name the component, or fix the spelling

rules.title: Login manifest order
rules.message: With <login>: the xios://apps/login.xml process is onLoad before the main process; the app's own view and process are onRequest
rules.fix: Reorder the manifest
